VBO:0200901.summary: Friendly and people-oriented, Miniature Schnoodles often enjoy joining outings, playing and settling close to their people. This Miniature Schnauzer–Miniature Poodle cross can be quick to learn and may announce visitors with a bark. Its small, sturdy form spans wavy and curly coats, with first crosses and later Poodle backcrosses represented.
VBO:0200901.shortDescription: Sociable and active, Miniature Schnoodles often enjoy outings, learning and lap time; their coats can be wavy or curly.
